description: Analyzes research grant portfolio health for each PI. Detects upcoming funding gaps, scores No-Cost Extension (NCE) risk, computes portfolio health scores, and identifies sponsor-specific submission timing patterns. The 'Grant Cliff Detector' flags PIs with grants ending and no follow-on awards.

sponsor_column.description: Sponsor/funder name column (optional — enables diversity scoring)

submission_date_column.description: Proposal submission date column (optional — enables sponsor timing analysis)

lookback_months.description: Months of history to consider for trend analysis
